package generationfixture_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"generationfixture/dto"
	"generationfixture/mapper"
	"generationfixture/model"
	"github.com/kuangshp/gorm-plus/validation"
	"github.com/shopspring/decimal"
	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

func TestJSONRequestDatabaseResponse(t *testing.T) { // 验证生成的字符串 DTO、Mapper 和 VO 经数据库往返不重复编码或损失精度。
	db, err := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "json.db")))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pool, _ := db.DB()
	t.Cleanup(func() { pool.Close() })
	if err := db.Exec("CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, amount NUMERIC, rate REAL, enabled BOOL, payload BLOB, attributes JSONB, created_at DATETIME, deleted_at DATETIME)").Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m := mapper.NewItemsMapper()
	for _, raw := range []string{
		`{"color":"红色","nested":{"id":9007199254740993,"amount":12.34567890123456789},"list":[true,null,"x"]}`,
		`[{"id":1},{"id":2}]`, `{}`, `[]`, `null`, `"hello"`,
	} {
		t.Run(raw, func(t *testing.T) {
			var req dto.CreateItemsDTO
			body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"name": "JSON test", "attributes": raw})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if req.Attributes != raw {
				t.Fatalf("DTO string changed: %q", req.Attributes)
			}
			if err := validation.Validate(&req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			entity := m.DtoToEntity(&req, decimal.Zero, 0)
			if !bytes.Equal(entity.Attributes, []byte(raw)) {
				t.Fatalf("input changed: %s", entity.Attributes)
			}
			if err := db.Create(entity).Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var loaded model.ItemsEntity
			if err := db.First(&loaded, entity.ID).Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			response, err := json.Marshal(m.EntityToVO(&loaded))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
			if err := json.Unmarshal(response, &fields); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var value string
			if err := json.Unmarshal(fields["attributes"], &value); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("response must contain a string: %s, %v", response, err)
			}
			if value != raw {
				t.Fatalf("JSON string changed: %s", response)
			}
		})
	}
	// SQLite 的 JSONB 声明具有数值亲和性；纯数字 JSON 单独验证转换，避免数据库改写字段类型。
	var scalar dto.CreateItemsDTO
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":"scalar","attributes":"9007199254740993"}`), &scalar); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validation.Validate(&scalar); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if response := m.EntityToVO(m.DtoToEntity(&scalar, decimal.Zero, 0)); response.Attributes != "9007199254740993" {
		t.Fatalf("scalar JSON text changed: %+v", response)
	}
	var req dto.ModifyItemsDTO
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"id":"17","name":"JSON test","attributes":"{\"enabled\":true}"}`), &req); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if req.ID != 17 || req.Attributes != `{"enabled":true}` {
		t.Fatalf("modify fields lost: %+v", req)
	}
	if err := validation.Validate(&req.CreateItemsDTO); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("JSON field validation: %v", err)
	}
	for _, attributes := range []string{`{"bad":}`, `plain text`} {
		if err := validation.Validate(&dto.CreateItemsDTO{Name: "invalid", Attributes: attributes}); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted malformed JSON string: %q", attributes)
		}
	}
	var empty dto.CreateItemsDTO
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":"optional"}`), &empty); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validation.Validate(&empty); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("optional JSON string: %v", err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"attributes":{"enabled":true}}`), &empty); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted object for a string field")
	}
	if _, err := json.Marshal(m.EntityToVO(&model.ItemsEntity{})); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SQL NULL response: %v", err)
	}
}
